name: Microwave Quinoa Veggie Bowl
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce and juice of ½ lime
steps: Place the quinoa and water in a large bowl, cover loosely and microwave on high for 5 minutes, then at 50% for 5 minutes. Stand covered for 5 minutes and fluff.
In another bowl, microwave the vegetables and edamame with 2 tbsp water covered for 4 minutes.
Mix the oil, ginger, soy sauce and lime juice.
Divide the quinoa between two bowls and top with the vegetables.
Drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with chilli flakes and coriander.
note: Edamame and quinoa together supply over 20 g of plant protein per serving.
